sentences.text: Noguerornis gonzalezi is the sole species within the genus Noguerornis, which belongs to the extinct avian clade Enantiornithes.
This genus was formally described by Lacasa-Ruiz in 1989.
Researchers suggest that Noguerornis may be related to the genus Iberomesornis.
Fossils of this bird have been found in the La Pedrera de Rúbies Formation at El Montsec, Spain.
The fossil record for Noguerornis spans from 125.77 to 121.4 million years ago within the Barremian stage.
While Noguerornis is a confirmed member of the Enantiornithes clade, its exact relationship to Iberomesornis remains a subject of ongoing scientific discussion.
